# WG19 · Xuất CSV cho Excel (tải tệp)

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#bind`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › bind()` `#export`: fetches `API + '/export?month=' + state.month` with the role headers, turns the blob into an object URL and clicks a hidden link with `download = 'Pema-tien-thu-thuat-' + month + '.csv'`.
- The file has a BOM and the columns Ngay, Ho so, Thu thuat, Bac si, Doanh so, Co so, Ty le %, Tien thu thuat, Trang thai (ASCII headers).
- Inventory note: The button downloads Pema-tien-thu-thuat-<month>.csv (BOM, columns Ngay, Ho so, Thu thuat, Bac si, Doanh so, Co so, Ty le %, Tien thu thuat, Trang thai). The browser's download UI is native.
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"wait":"#export"}; it must show "Xuất CSV cho Excel".

## Required text (keep verbatim)

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
- Native download: file name "Pema-tien-thu-thuat-2026-09.csv" (the browser download UI is not part of the page).

## Differences from the app design
- App H3 has no CSV export.

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- The harness opens the context with `acceptDownloads: false`; the snapshot is the page before the click.
- Canvas: as WG16; the download bubble shows the file name of the manifest.
